speaker: Mikel Arteta
quote_text:
Hi everyone, hope everyone's well. If you're  ready, if you have a question, raise your hand and  
I'll come to you. Oh, yeah, thanks, Ray. Sorry.  These ones as well? Yeah, just move on. Okay,  
sorry guys. Already? Okay, if you have a question,  I'll come to you. We'll kick off with Mike from  
the Mirror. Was that a surreal atmosphere? Did  it feel a bit like a phony war tonight? Well,  
they told us that obviously with the result that  we had from the first leg that it wasn't going to  
be full, but yeah, we had to continue and do the  work in the manner that we wanted to finish the  
competition. Unfortunately, we haven't managed  to win the game. But yeah, we decided to make  
a lot of rotation as well. You could tell in the  second-half that we were tired, we were late to be  
much more dominant in the position half and much  more consistent, especially when we didn't have  
the ball. But overall, very happy because we have  for the 2nd consecutive season in the Champions  
League quarter-finals. We're going to travel  to Madrid. But unfortunately, we don't know who  
against yet. Ed Mikhail. I must have been very  pleased with Raheem Sterling's performance. For  
most of the game until the very end when he got  booked, he's going to miss the first leg. Yeah,  
yeah, I was. I'm very happy for him and for a  lot of individuals as well that they haven't  
had a lot of minutes recently. You could  tell in the second-half that we lacked that  
physical capabilities to make certain effort and  certain arrives to certain spaces in the right  
time. But overall, very happy that they got  the minutes and they responded. With Raheem,  
did you see this confidence sort of coming back  after you know he was involved in the first goal  
and then he really looked back to his old self?  Yeah, in the second one and then he does the last  
final action as well that he can score the  third goal and the keeper makes a save the way  
he tracked back as well as to the corner in the  last action when he got booked. That's the kind  
of play that we want to see. Jordan, son. Okay,  when you first came back to the club as manager,  
I think this is one of the aims to get Arsenal  consistently qualifying for the latter stages.  
How proud are you that you're managing to do that  now consistently. I think it's the first time in  
15 years that you've done it back-to-back. Yeah,  well, that's the difficulty of it. So yeah, we  
have to value that and recognise that it is very  difficult to do it. We've done it consistently and  
now we want to make the next step, which is going  to be really difficult, but we are very capable  
of doing. Do you have any preference? No, because  they are so different, both of them, the styles,  
the managers, the history of them. That we know  about the difficulty for sure, but I cannot  
tell you one or the other. Tom for Bulletin.  Zinchenko on the scoresheet as well tonight,  
playing in a more, perhaps the most advanced role  we might have seen him in in that attack midfield  
position. Striking from outside the box, there's  been a lot of focus around his ball-striking in  
this season as well. Is that the type of scenario  that you'd like Martin to get into what Zinny did  
today and score that type of job? Yeah, and he's  done it, Martin as well. I think Zinny's finish  
was... great. He's got his ability to do that, to  carry the ball and those spaces to put the ball  
in the back of the net. Really happy because we  find another solution as well to fit his qualities  
and what the team is demanding at the moment. So  really good to have him in that condition. What  
do you feel, Mikel, that you've learned from your  experiences from last season's knockout stages of  
the Champions League that you could take into such  an experienced side in either Real or Atlético  
Madrid? Well, the first thing that you have to  be at your best when it comes to that, for the  
two games, for every minute, don't give anything  away because they're going to take it. And today  
we've seen with the two goals that we conceded  as well. So that's a big learning. And at the  
end of the game, we're going to be deciding the  boxes, individual talent, individual performance  
is crucial. And then creating an unbelievable  atmosphere when we have the opportunity to play  
at home. That is crucial. Matt and Damon. Hello,  can you tell us, tell us why it is important for  
you to be in the last eight again and ask to be  back? Why it's important? Because we want to win.  
I mean, and to win, you're going to have to go  through the stages and because the club needs  
it. You know, we are a club, a team that wants to  be the best and want to be competing with the best  
clubs in the world. In order to that, you have  to constantly be there, and it's very difficult,  
but we've done it for two years in a row, and  we have the capacity and the ability to do it  
even better. Hamza from the Times. Good evening,  Mikel. Myles, I just wanted to know if you've seen  
in the long term in midfield or at left-back.  Or a bit both? Yeah, both. He can play in both  
positions and in relation to the player that he  plays as a full-back as well, they can interact  
and interchange positions. He played as a  six, you know, he was developing the academy  
as a six as well. So while he's doing, this isn't  something new for him. So I think it's much more  
to it to play in midfield. He's done really well  tonight as well. I think he was very consistent  
in his actions and really happy what he's doing.  Okay, fine. David, did you have one from? Yeah,  
yeah. You said you want to get even better than  quarter-finals. How can you do that independently  
from which Madrid side are you going to face?  Well, last year we played Bayern and with the  
history of those clubs and how consistent they've  been the last 20-25 years being there and we were  
right there in the home game. We had them under  the ropes, they escaped and when we were there,  
we were a bit short to get that final  stage. So hopefully we learn. We are  
better than them. And we can make it happen.  Okay, thanks everyone. Good night. Thank you.
title: Mikel Arteta post-match press conference | Arsenal 2-2 PSV (Agg 9-3)
